scope: native processor foundation, not vision-language inference

profiles.normalization: F32 RGB/255, subtract mean, divide std; retain HWC storage
profiles.resize: Keys bicubic a=-0.5, horizontal then vertical, 22-bit fixed coefficients, round/clamp U8 after each pass

geometry.rounding: F32 scale and ceil; centered floor offsets

profiles.patch_layout: raster patches, channel then patch y/x
profiles.alignment_note: Pinned GGUF reference pads; source HF config center-crops. Legacy feature layer mapping remains unresolved. This profile is specific to the selected reference, not a family-wide qualification.

profiles.normalization: F32 RGB/255, subtract mean, divide std; retain HWC storage
profiles.resize: Keys bicubic a=-0.5, horizontal then vertical, 22-bit fixed coefficients, round/clamp U8 after each pass

geometry.rounding: F32 scale and nearest ties-to-even; floor/ceil at pixel limits

profiles.patch_layout: 2x2 merge groups, channel then duplicated temporal frame then patch y/x
profiles.alignment_note: Reference token limits explicitly set to 4/16384 to match source pixels; defaults differ.

formats.png: 8-bit grayscale/gray-alpha/RGB/RGBA; validate all chunk CRCs; no palette/APNG/tRNS/ICC/cICP
formats.jpeg: baseline 8-bit grayscale/RGB, one interleaved scan; no progressive/CMYK/YCCK/ICC/MPO

orientation: Apply primary EXIF orientation 1-8 before resize, without an oriented source copy
alpha: Discard alpha, retain RGB channels; grayscale replicated to RGB
color: Use decoded channel values without gamma/chromaticity transforms; embedded ICC/cICP rejected
decoder_reference: Pillow 13.0.0; PNG exact and JPEG maximum channel difference 2; downstream comparisons use identical canonical RGB pixels
admission: Reject canonical output exceeding resource limits; never shrink resolution to fit a budget. Ordered batch reserves aggregate encoded bytes plus peak sequential processor and retained outputs.
